steps: Install the S'more app from the official Google Play listing (com.lab465.SmoreApp).
Grant the lock-screen permission so S'more can show ads and content on your lock screen.
Use your phone normally — points are credited daily for having the S'more lock screen installed.
Optionally earn extra in the Earn section: complete surveys, watch videos, finish offers, and refer friends.

When you have enough points, open the Rewards section, choose a retailer gift card (100 points = $1), and cash out — the first redemption requires waiting 10 days after install; after that, redeem anytime with enough points.
